d: The US, Japan, Australia and the Philippines have decided to upgrade their defensive grouping, known as the Squad. The bloc is planning to build a new combined coordination centre in the Philippines. The Squad is also planning to increase the size, scope and complexity of their joint military exercises. Firstpost explains what the Squad grouping is, and how it differs from the earlier Quad group. Hem Kaur Saroya looks at the latest developments in the context of the US goal to contain China.
